title: Graphic & Motion Designer
description:
Medifort Wellness Hospital, Bhagalpur, is hiring a Graphic & Motion Designer. Skills: Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, graphic design, video editing, motion graphics & branding. Portfolio mandatory.Graduate/Diploma in Design or Multimedia; 2–5 years’ experience. Freshers with strong portfolios welcome. Must have creative skills and proficiency in Adobe design tools.

Key Skills: Motion graphics,Editing,Social media,Video,Aftereffects,Motion,Story Writing,Media
